about_the_game:
The trial version Demo allows players to freely enjoy all content of the first chapter, including the story mode, collection gameplay, and other features.

Game Introduction

This is an interactive movie game. In a bizarre dream, you find yourself trapped by three enchantresses who overwhelm you without warning... But when the alarm rings and you wake up—they’ve somehow entered your real life?!

Xu Zhaozhao – Pure, adorable, and radiating sweet energy—

Yet her heart seems to hide a secret tied to you...

Perhaps at night, you can coax this capricious little demon into revealing the answers you seek.

Zhong Ran – Graceful, wise, and impeccably poised—

But the storms in her heart may not match her calm smile...

If you’re willing, a simple stethoscope might let you hear her true heartbeat when you’re alone.

Yu Zhi – Independent, decisive, and fiercely alluring—

What could have driven her to abandon everything for you?

When night falls, if you heed her plea, she’ll surrender herself to you—body and soul...

Now, it’s your choices that will shape this love story—but wait, this shouldn’t be a fantasy game. So who are they at night? And whose whispers linger by your pillow?

Then, let your choices determine this romance—
Wait, isn't this supposed to be a fantasy game? So, who are they when night falls? And what is it that whispers softly by your pillow?

Experience the Features

  • Welcome to the Succubus's Realm—
    In a world of illusions and realities, which is more genuine—the smiles of daylight or the whispers of the night? Whether it's them or us, adults always have secrets too intimate to share. At night, she will stay by your side in a different form. If you wish to hear her sincere response, you must answer her questions with equal honesty.

  • Multi-Dimensional Character Portrayals
    When your gaze lingers on someone long enough, you'll gradually uncover the side of her that remains hidden from others—perhaps passionate, perhaps innocent, perhaps intense, perhaps alluring. Whatever it may be, it's a side reserved only for you.

  • A Humorous Main Story with Free Choices
    The boss is wildly imaginative, team-building activities are all about water fights, and projects are a piece of cake—yet emotions and the future remain shrouded in uncertainty... Will you start from scratch with her, savoring the subtle curve of her smile and the flutter of her eyelashes in everyday moments? Or will you lose yourself in her gentle charm, safeguarding the tides of her heart? Or perhaps become the right hand of that enigmatic rose, unlocking the depths of her long-guarded heart? Success or failure, joy or sorrow, tenderness or thorns, sweetness or bitterness—your choices will shape the story between you and them.

A Final Note: Why Did We Make This Game?
The initial version was criticized by friends as being "too technical and nerdy," so I reflected and rewrote it multiple times. Eventually, I decided to pen this message as a personal note:

To answer the question at its core—just as water must have a source, we were initially inspired by similar games and wanted to create a story that could leave a lasting impression on players' hearts.

So, perhaps it's more fitting to phrase the question this way: What sets our game apart?

From the first day of development to the last, we adhered to one principle: to deliver a romance experience that feels as authentic as possible.

In reality, whether it's men or women, including ourselves, we all wear "masks." Often, when you first meet a woman, you might think she's perfect in every way. But as time passes, you'll peel back her layers like an onion, gradually discovering her true self. Usually, compared to the initial impression, she may seem further from "perfect" now.

At this point, will you firmly hold her hand? Or cut your losses and walk away? Or perhaps stand by her silently? In matters of the heart, there are countless choices, but the most important thing is—there is no standard answer. That's why, in our game, there are only different kinds of love, no wrong kinds of love.

As development progressed, we came to a realization: if we were to pursue authenticity, the pacing of the game would naturally "slow down," requiring players to be patient and reflective. In a world where both entertainment and emotional connections are accelerating, this approach is somewhat countercultural. Once, a friend who tested the game early remarked that this isn't a "mindless pleasure" kind of game and expressed concern about its market appeal. After much thought, we found it hard to refute this point, yet we remain committed to our vision. Perhaps it's the stubborn sentimentality of a few nostalgic singles.

Lastly, we also hope to use this game as a means to explore how deeply we understand one of humanity's most beautiful emotions—love. This may sound audacious, but for us, it's a precious opportunity. Just like love and friendship, when you experience it firsthand, it leaves its mark on you.

Although we strived to portray the emotions and girls we never fully understood in the past as authentically as possible, we must admit that due to limitations in experience and skill, there are areas where we fell short. If given the chance, we'd love to discuss this with everyone who plays the game and learn from each other.

Unintentionally, I've written quite a bit, and I think it's time to wrap up. There's a quote that feels fitting to end with (even if others find it puzzling):
“It was the season of Light, it was the season of Darkness, it was the spring of hope, it was the winter of despair, we had everything before us, we had nothing before us.”

Let’s encourage each other!
